For example, if the value is '55.', Chrome will be updated to any minor version of 55 (e.g. 55.24.34.0 or 55.60.2.10). If the value is '55.2.', Chrome will be updated to any minor version of 55.2 (e.g. 55.2.34.100 or 55.2.2.1). If the value is '55.24.34.1', Chrome will be updated to that specific version only. Chrome may stop updating or not rollback if the specified version is more than three major milestones old.
